title: Multistep synthesis sequence toward dolutegravir
protocol: The first operation of a seven-step sequence combined methyl 4-methoxyacetoacetate (2.0 mmol, 1.0 equiv) with dimethylformamide dimethylacetal (1.6 equiv) in acetic acid at 0.20 M. The batch operation was heated at 80 C for 60 min and furnished the vinylogous amide intermediate in 96% yield. The requested design objective is an integrated, staged continuous process through the reported dolutegravir sequence, with explicit residence time and additions for every stage.
objective: Translate the batch protocol into a feasible, safe, and testable continuous-flow design.
